Name: Coop and Barn Facelift for 1.6
Author: thirtythreepaces
Description:
[u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27521?tab=description]UPDATE: vikich3rry has made a version of this that retains the clean interior, go check it out!![/url][/u]

In 1.6, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nykachu/about-me]nykachu’s[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874]Coop and Barn Facelift[/url] mod broke because it disabled auto-feeders in upgraded coops and barns. This mod incorporates[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LadyChainsaw/about-me] LadyChainsaw’s[/url] fix for the coding so that it will work fine. Additionally, I added a recolor option to match the interiors from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/grapeponta/about-me]grapeponta's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url].

See nykachu’s mod for more details and a catalogue of wall colors.

[b]Compatibility: [/b]This mod is compatible with other mods that change building interiors as long as they do not affect "CoopTiles". If such a mod does, check to see if there is an option to disable that aspect.

[b]NOTE:[/b] Unlike the original mod, this does [b]not[/b] change the size of the map or fix the "shabbiness" of the barns and coops. I am not sure how to fix the auto-feeder issue while retaining these changes. If anyone knows, feel free to tell me!

[b]Config Options:[/b]
[u]Wood Color:[/u]
"vanilla", "TD", “VPR”
[list]
[*]Vanilla: Wood that matches the base game.
[*]TD: Dark wood to match A Toned Down Stardew Valley.
[*]VPR: Softer wood to match Vibrant Pastoral Recolor.
[/list]
[u]Wall Color:[/u]
“vanilla”, “red”, “orange”, “green”, “teal”, “blue”, “purple”, “pink”, “pastelpink”, “cream”, “chocolate”,
“tdred”, “tdblue”, “tdgreen”, “tdpurple”, “tdwhite”, “tdgold”, “tdrosegold”, “tdchocolate”
[list]
[*]TD colors are slightly desaturated and match best with the TD setting.
[/list]
[u]Recolor Craftables:[/u]
“true”, “false”
[list]
[*]When set to “true”, the hay hopper and egg incubator will match the selected wood color.
[/list]
[u]Recolor Machines:[/u]
“true”, “false”
[list]
[*]When set to “true”, the ornamental hay bale, heater, and auto-grabber will match the selected wood color.
[*]Note: The VPR setting here was made for my own personal taste. The hay bale will match VPR, the heater is the same white as the TD setting, and the auto-grabber is the same as the vanilla asset.
[/list]
[u]Recolor Hay:[/u]
“true”, “false”
[list]
[*]When “true”, hay will be less saturated when TD or VPR is selected.
[/list]
[b]To install:[/b][u][b]
[/b][/u][list=1]
[*]Make sure you have SMAPI and the latest version of Content Patcher (at least 2.2.0) installed.
[*]Download, unzip, and place “[CP] Coop and Barn Facelift for 1.6” into your mods folder.
[*]To customize the mod, run SMAPI to generate a “config.json” file and either edit it manually or with Generic Mod Config Menu (I highly recommend the latter).
[*]Done!

[/list][b]To uninstall:[/b][list=1]
[*]Remove “[CP] Coop and Barn Facelift for 1.6” from your mods folder.

[/list]Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nykachu/about-me]nykachu[/url] for the original mod, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LadyChainsaw/about-me]LadyChainsaw[/url] for the patch, and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/grapeponta/about-me]grapeponta[/url] for the VPR assets!
